field.label: Create scheduled speedtests
field.help: Adds a cron task that runs speedtests between 00:00 and 06:00, against the servers that measured the line fastest so far

field.label: Frequency
field.help: Number of speedtests between 00:00 and 06:00, spread evenly (1 to 6)

field.label: Schedule offset
field.help: Minutes past the hour the speedtests run at (0 to 59). The traffic shaper is set 15 minutes after the last speedtest

field.label: Multiple
field.help: Number of speedtests to run at each scheduled interval
